name: assistance_bandit
intended_use: Select an assistance mode from the admissible set the safety envelope permits, balancing helpfulness against over-assistance.
out_of_scope_use: Must not select outside the admissible set, and must not explore on a context the envelope marks high risk.
training_data: 3000 synthetic logged decisions with recorded propensities under an epsilon-greedy logging policy.
selection_criterion: lowest cumulative regret in online simulation
limitations: Reward is simulated. The real reward signal (task resolved, control revoked, session abandoned) must be instrumented before deployment.
Assumes reward is linear in the features; the true relationship is probably not.
Exploration means an occasional deliberately suboptimal mode. Set ML_BANDIT_EXPLORATION=0 to disable it.
ethical_considerations: Exploration happens on real assistance sessions with vulnerable users, so it is confined to the admissible set and never trades safety for information.
Reward penalises over-assistance as well as under-assistance, encoding that doing things for someone is not automatically helping them.
